Title: One sentence
Prompt: Rewrite the request as: who, does what, so that. If the notes do not say why, write 'why not stated'.
Check: You did not invent the why.

Title: Acceptance
Prompt: Write acceptance checks a person can run without reading your mind. Use the inputs I provided.

Title: Out of scope
Prompt: List three nearby ideas that this requirement does not include.
Check: The developer can see the boundary.

Title: Edge cases
Prompt: List empty, duplicate, and permission failures for this requirement. Mark any you cannot answer as a question.
Check: Questions are not disguised as facts.

Title: Plain words
Prompt: Replace jargon with the words a new teammate would use. Do not change the decision.

Title: Ready check
Use when: Before it goes to a developer.
Prompt: Say what is still missing: data, design, copy, or a decision. Do not fill the gap yourself.
